source.name: Escape in a nested menubar submenu must close only that submenu and return focus to its parent item
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/NickDJM/accessible-menu/issues/533) at 4b8e65db81f40c0c032db1c8567615bbe3da32f6. Blind to the maintainers' fix cfb4dc85f57e59c3e1ca3c8835618101a6e818b9; routing auto.

journey.title: Escape closes only the innermost open submenu
journey.goal: Escape in the Facts submenu returns to Facts while the About submenu stays open

functionalJourney.title: Open nested submenus with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: About and Facts submenus open on click

guards.title: Escape in a first-level submenu returns to the menubar
guards.goal: Escape in the About submenu closes it and focuses About

plan.root_cause: The Escape key handler in submenu menus incorrectly closes all submenus of the root menu instead of closing only the current submenu and returning focus to its parent menu item.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the Escape key handler in the submenu case (else branch of _handleKeyup in Menubar) to find the toggle that controls this submenu via parentMenu.submenuToggles, close that toggle, and then focus the parent menu item.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Escape will close only the innermost open submenu and move focus to its parent menu item, leaving any outer submenus open as required by the menubar design pattern.
functional_risks: If the toggle lookup fails (e.g., missing parentMenu or submenuToggles), the submenu will not close, but the guard prevents errors.
For deeply nested submenus, only the immediate parent toggle is closed, which is correct behavior.
No risk of breaking other keyboard shortcuts as the change is isolated to the Escape case.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape when focus is inside a submenu with an open parent submenu results in focus returning to the parent menu item and the parent submenu remaining open (aria-expanded true).
Verify that Escape works when only one submenu is open: it closes that submenu and returns focus to the corresponding menubar item.
Ensure that Escape does not cause unexpected focus loss or closure of unrelated UI elements.
Confirm that the fix does not regress the existing Escape behavior for top-level menubar (closing open submenus or controller).
